From 69678bcd4d2dedbc3e8fcd6d7d99f283d83c531a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2018 12:42:34 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] udp: fix SO_BINDTODEVICE

Damir reported a breakage of SO_BINDTODEVICE for UDP sockets.
In absence of VRF devices, after commit fb74c27735f0 ("net:
ipv4: add second dif to udp socket lookups") the dif mismatch
isn't fatal anymore for UDP socket lookup with non null
sk_bound_dev_if, breaking SO_BINDTODEVICE semantics.

This changeset addresses the issue making the dif match mandatory
again in the above scenario.

Reported-by: Damir Mansurov <dnman@oktetlabs.ru>
Fixes: fb74c27735f0 ("net: ipv4: add second dif to udp socket lookups")
Fixes: 1801b570dd2a ("net: ipv6: add second dif to udp socket lookups")
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>
Acked-by: David Ahern <dsahern@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/net/ipv4/udp.c b/net/ipv4/udp.c
index 24b5c59b1c53..c2a292dfd137 100644
--- a/net/ipv4/udp.c
+++ b/net/ipv4/udp.c
@@ -401,9 +401,9 @@ static int compute_score(struct sock *sk, struct net *net,
 		bool dev_match = (sk->sk_bound_dev_if == dif ||
 				  sk->sk_bound_dev_if == sdif);
 
-		if (exact_dif && !dev_match)
+		if (!dev_match)
 			return -1;
-		if (sk->sk_bound_dev_if && dev_match)
+		if (sk->sk_bound_dev_if)
 			score += 4;
 	}
 

diff --git a/net/ipv6/udp.c b/net/ipv6/udp.c
index 4ec76a87aeb8..ea0730028e5d 100644
--- a/net/ipv6/udp.c
+++ b/net/ipv6/udp.c
@@ -148,9 +148,9 @@ static int compute_score(struct sock *sk, struct net *net,
 		bool dev_match = (sk->sk_bound_dev_if == dif ||
 				  sk->sk_bound_dev_if == sdif);
 
-		if (exact_dif && !dev_match)
+		if (!dev_match)
 			return -1;
-		if (sk->sk_bound_dev_if && dev_match)
+		if (sk->sk_bound_dev_if)
 			score++;
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/ipv4/udp.c`**
   - The condition checking for device match (`dev_match`) has been modified. 
   - The line `if (exact_dif && !dev_match)` has been changed to `if (!dev_match)`, making the device interface match mandatory for UDP socket lookups.
   - The line `if (sk->sk_bound_dev_if && dev_match)` has been simplified to `if (sk->sk_bound_dev_if)`, removing the dependency on `dev_match` for incrementing the score.

2. **File: `net/ipv6/udp.c`**
   - Similar changes have been made as in `udp.c` for IPv4.
   - The condition `if (exact_dif && !dev_match)` has been changed to `if (!dev_match)`, enforcing the device interface match requirement.
   - The line `if (sk->sk_bound_dev_if && dev_match)` has also been simplified to `if (sk->sk_bound_dev_if)`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in both `net/ipv4/udp.c` and `net/ipv6/udp.c` are closely related as they address the same issue regarding the `SO_BINDTODEVICE` functionality for UDP sockets in both IPv4 and IPv6 contexts. The changes ensure that the device interface match is enforced consistently across both protocols, thereby restoring the intended semantics of `SO_BINDTODEVICE`. This alignment in logic across the two files indicates a unified approach to fixing the bug reported by Damir Mansurov, ensuring that the behavior of UDP sockets is consistent regardless of the IP version being used.
